author: DonaldMyTrump
body: It has been 5 days and I have not received a response. The developer ALM has come to me and taunted me asking "how is your appeal going" I would like to escalate my appeal to admins at this point. I would also like it if admins responded to my evidence of abuse in the reading of my friend's ip. I would prefer it if Posighdun answered my appeal since I believe the other admins hold a significant bias against me. I would also appreciate it if TS appeals were unarchived to allow a discussion between staff and community.
